text: The towpath turns to churned black mud beside {place}. Your boots sink and squelch with every step under {pack}.

choices.label: Pick a high line along the verge
choices.result: Slower going through nettles and roots, and you sit slightly higher in view.

choices.label: Plough straight through the ruts
choices.result: Cold sludge coats your cuffs and lowers and your ankles chill.

text: A narrow wooden stile blocks the field edge ahead of {place}. Swinging {pack} over the top rail pulls hard on your lower back.

choices.label: Unclip and lift {pack} over first
choices.result: Careful and steady, keeping your balance on slick timber.

choices.label: Heave straight over with it on
choices.result: Your shoulder straps bite deep as you drop onto the far side.

text: A sharp shower sweeps across {place}, drumming on your hood at {hour}. Water beads off some fabric and darkens the rest.

choices.label: Throw on the {warmestLayer}
choices.result: Heavy and warm, though the outer face takes the brunt of the rain.

choices.label: Drape the poncho over {pack}
choices.result: Your kit stays drier, though the poncho flaps in the breeze.

choices.label: Keep walking and let it pass
choices.result: The squall passes, leaving your sleeves damp and clammy.

text: A dog walker rounds the bend near {place} with a spaniel trotting ahead. They offer a brief nod as they pass.

choices.label: Say evening and keep moving
choices.result: Polite and unhurried, though they now know someone is out.

choices.label: Step off the path till they pass
choices.result: You stay out of their line of sight while the dog sniffs the grass.

text: A herd of heifers blocks the pasture near {place}, heavy and curious. The cows are judging you from ten paces away.

choices.label: Give them a wide berth round the edge
choices.result: Extra steps along the hedge, with no hoofprints near your heels.

choices.label: Walk steadily through without stopping
choices.result: A few shift sideways, watching you all the way to the gate.

text: At {place}, a cast-iron swing bridge sits unlatched across the cut. Dark canal water laps against the timber.

choices.label: Swing it across quietly and cross
choices.result: The iron groans softly before you pull it back into place.

choices.label: Take the longer footpath round
choices.result: Quiet and unhurried, adding miles to your legs.

text: Warm light spills from a canal-side pub window near {place} at {hour}. Inside looks dry, bright, and very warm.

choices.label: Push past into the cold dusk
choices.result: The cold hits harder once the warm glow fades behind you.

choices.label: Stop for one quick drink at the bar
choices.result: Your fingers thaw out, though you set off later in the dark.

text: Dusk settles fast over {place} at {hour}, turning hedges into flat grey shapes. Ruts and roots are hard to read.

choices.label: Switch on {torch} on low
choices.result: You see every step clearly, though a beam travels across open ground.

choices.label: Walk by twilight and night eyes
choices.result: Slow work, but your eyes adjust to the gloom.

text: You pass a tap near {place} with {temp} air and water running cold. Carrying extra water adds weight at once.

choices.label: Top up the flask with hot or cold
choices.result: The extra weight pulls on {pack}, but a warm sip waits later.

choices.label: Top up a spare bottle
choices.result: Clean water secured for camp without relying on a canal.

choices.label: Carry on light and travel faster
choices.result: Easier on the legs now, though supplies are tighter later.

text: A sharp rub starts on your heel on the approach to {place}. Ignore it now and every step after dark will hurt.

choices.label: Patch it cleanly from the kit
choices.result: A few minutes kneeling by the path saves a ruined morning.

choices.label: Adjust your sock and press on
choices.result: Dry wool helps ease the friction for now.

choices.label: Grimace and keep marching
choices.result: The hot spot stings harder with each half-hour.
